confirmation_scope: mandatory core benchmarks and conditional WorkArena++ extension
legacy five-application evidence remains pilot and engineering only
Traditional adaptation failures remain in the deployment-effectiveness denominator
pure-visual progress detection may use only admitted screenshot-derived and action-state signals
supersedes: study-created workflow slots used as confirmatory tasks
study-created fault and UI-evolution conditions used as confirmatory benchmark conditions

estimand.question: Which Web UI testing abstraction is effective, reliable, and economical for which externally defined task characteristics?
estimand.unit: benchmark x official_task_id x configuration x repetition

mandatory_core.task_semantics_policy: official instruction and official evaluator unchanged
official instruction, goal images, and official evaluator unchanged
official step sequence, assertions, pass/fail label, and application state unchanged
mandatory_core.scale_note: The final ISSTA page/artifact and the preprint describe different task-count snapshots; compute the denominator from the pinned artifact rather than copying a reported count.

objective_inclusion_gate: a reproducible ServiceNow instance is available before task screening
the same pinned instance and official evaluator are usable by all three paradigms
reset and credential handling pass without outcome-dependent exclusions
conditional_extension.failure_action: exclude the benchmark as a whole with a benchmark-level exclusion record before observing arm outcomes

external_validity_only.purpose: check whether major controlled-benchmark findings remain visible on current websites

eligible_task_set_freeze.post_freeze_change_policy: versioned protocol amendment plus full affected-arm rerun; no in-place task-list edits

inclusion_criteria.rule: The task is an official task in the pinned public benchmark release.
The official instruction and evaluator are available and can be preserved without semantic edits.
The task is executable entirely through the benchmark-provided browser environment.
All three paradigms can in principle attempt the same semantic goal through their declared interfaces.
The environment has a reproducible reset or benchmark-defined reinitialization procedure.
The official evaluator is deterministic or has a documented, pre-registered tolerance.
The task requires no secret, external application, or privileged information unavailable through ordinary browser use.

exclusion_reasons.rule: unsupported external application or non-browser action
credential, CAPTCHA, geographic, or account dependency cannot be reproducibly provisioned
pinned benchmark environment is broken or unavailable
official evaluator is absent or confirmed defective
reset or task reinitialization is not repeatable
task is not theoretically executable by all three paradigm interfaces
license or redistribution terms prevent the required experimental or artifact use
duplicate official task instance after benchmark-defined canonicalization

forbidden_exclusion_reasons: one or more arms performed poorly
a model or framework timed out after task-list freeze
the task reduces an expected paradigm advantage
the task is expensive after it has been sampled and frozen

common_inputs: same viewport and browser version within a matched block
same wall-clock timeout within a matched block

disallowed: URL string unless rendered in browser chrome

allowed_observations: visible-interactable accessibility projection with ephemeral target IDs
hybrid_agent.ephemeral_target_rule: target IDs are regenerated from the current visible projection and cannot encode selector, evaluator, or application identity

allowed_runtime_information: public DOM and accessibility information available to Playwright
browser events used only for synchronization
official task parameters contained in the task instruction
allowed_actions: Playwright browser actions through reviewed locators
disallowed_runtime_information: reference answer not present in the instruction
private application API used to solve the task
traditional_scripted_test.network_rule: network events may be awaited for synchronization but response payloads may not determine the semantic action or verdict

traditional_adaptation.estimand: a deployment bundle consisting of a frozen human-authored test plus its measured one-time engineering cost and repeated runtime behavior
author_inputs: ordinary browser access to the pinned environment
forbidden_author_inputs: official evaluator source or network-trace answer
reference trajectory unless the benchmark gives it equally as task specification
CUA or Hybrid trajectories and outcomes
procedure: register author identity pseudonym and start time
copy the official instruction verbatim into script metadata
implement only the interactions needed by that instruction
record every locator, assertion, synchronization primitive, and debug edit
perform semantic-equivalence review against the instruction without evaluator-source access
run a black-box conformance check using the official evaluator
freeze code hash before matched repeated execution
locator_priority: official stable test ID if publicly documented
traditional_adaptation.assertion_rule: script assertions may aid diagnostics but official task success is always determined by the unchanged official evaluator
traditional_adaptation.adaptation_failure_policy: retain in the denominator as a Traditional deployment failure after task-list freeze; do not exclude the official task

hard_freeze_rules.rule: Freeze and hash the eligible official task set before running any CUA, Hybrid, or Traditional arm.
hard_freeze_rules.violation: invalidate all affected runs and repeat them after a versioned amendment

hard_freeze_rules.rule: Traditional authoring and semantic review must be completed without evaluator internals and without CUA or Hybrid outcomes.
hard_freeze_rules.violation: invalidate the affected script and all runs produced from it

hard_freeze_rules.rule: Any change to task population, information boundary, evaluator, authoring protocol, retry rule, or primary metric requires a versioned amendment before new runs.
hard_freeze_rules.violation: keep old and new versions in separate strata; never pool them

analysis.rq1: mixed-effects logistic regression with paired task outcomes and benchmark/task random effects
analysis.rq3: task-level repeated-run reliability plus paired skew-robust cost and latency analysis
analysis.rq4: outcome-blind codebook development followed by double-coded failures and complementarity analysis
analysis.multiple_testing: Holm correction within pre-registered comparison families

blocking_gaps: pass local environment, evaluator-semantics, and three-reset gates for each benchmark (ATA currently has a remote-reset and agent-coupled evaluator finding)
populate and adjudicate outcome-blind included/excluded task tables before any arm execution
connect every benchmark adapter to the repaired pure-visual and canonical Hybrid boundary contracts
complete double-blind Traditional semantic-equivalence review, authoring-cost capture, and script freeze
wire benchmark-provenance run-record v1.0 into the append-only ledger and dashboard
run the held-out protocol pilot, freeze repetitions from power simulation, and obtain explicit confirmatory authorization

freeze_gates: benchmark versions and license terms recorded
included and excluded official task IDs adjudicated
task annotations and agreement statistics frozen
Traditional adaptation ledger and script-review protocol pass
pilot uses only the frozen eligible task population
prompts, framework versions, model configurations, budgets, retry rules, and scripts frozen
repetition count and analysis plan frozen from outcome-blind pilot power simulation
